content:
FastTrackr wrote this. We're one of the tools compared.

This page compares FastTrackr with four tools that come up in transition searches: Docupace, PreciseFP, OnBord and Laser App. FastTrackr's column describes what our product does today. The other columns quote each vendor's own site, with the date we checked it. There's no score and no ranking. Which tool fits depends on the move, the custodian and who does the work.

"Not stated on the page we checked" means we didn't find it in the text of that vendor's page on 2026-11-04. It doesn't mean the product can't do it. Vendor quotes are the vendor's own claims, and we haven't verified them.

What each vendor says on its own site

Docupace's transitions page says "Move advisors to your firm in weeks, not months" and claims "500 advisors and 120,000 client accounts in 2025" (docupace.com, checked 2026-11-04). Those are Docupace's own claims.

PreciseFP's homepage calls it "AI-Enabled Data Gathering, Built for Financial Advisors" (precisefp.com, checked 2026-11-04).

OnBord's transitions page leads with "Move to independence without slowing down" (onbord.io, checked 2026-11-04). It names no custodians there.

Laser App, now under iPipeline, is a forms library. Its product page lists "33,000+ forms" (ipipeline.com, checked 2026-11-04). We didn't find transition-specific content there.

Questions to ask any vendor

  • Which custodians are live today, and which are still coming?
  • How does the paperwork go out: e-signature, filled PDFs for a wet signature, or the counterparty's own template?
  • What happens after the client signs? Who follows NIGO rejections and status updates until each account is done?
  • What can you start from? In a breakaway the old firm doesn't hand over an export, so it depends on your data access rights. In an acquisition the old firm hands over its exports.
  • Is it software you run, a team that runs it for you, or both?

When another tool fits better

  • If your book is moving to BNY Pershing now, Dispatch and Feathery both name Pershing on their transitions pages (checked 2026-11-04). FastTrackr's Pershing support is coming soon.
  • If you mainly need a large forms library rather than a transition workflow, Laser App lists 33,000+ forms (checked 2026-11-04).

FAQs

Which custodians does FastTrackr support?

Fidelity, Charles Schwab and SEI, with full repapering. Goldman Sachs is live too: we deliver the data in Goldman's own format. BNY Pershing is coming soon.

What happens after the client signs?

FastTrackr tracks every account to the end, including NIGO and status updates.

Does FastTrackr publish its pricing?

No. Pricing isn't published.
